cards.title: Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.6 Safety Restrictions Bypassed
cards.body: TechCrunch testing found that Anthropic's sexual content restrictions on Claude models were easily circumvented. The discovery raises questions about the effectiveness of safety guardrails in advanced AI systems.

cards.title: Nvidia Partners With Cloverleaf on Data Centers
cards.body: Nvidia continues expanding its data center portfolio through partnership with developer Cloverleaf. The move underscores Nvidia's dominant position in AI infrastructure.

cards.title: Nvidia: AI Agent Harnesses Beat Model Quality
cards.body: Nvidia research demonstrates that fine-tuning agent harnesses matters more than raw model capability. Even weaker AI models can perform reliably with proper fine-tuning techniques.

cards.title: Starcloud Raises $250M for Orbital Data Centers
cards.body: Starcloud secured major funding as competition intensifies for space-based data center access. The startup aims to solve launch capacity constraints limiting orbital infrastructure growth.

cards.title: DOJ Investigating Andreessen Horowitz Conflict Issues
cards.body: The Department of Justice is investigating a16z for potential conflicts stemming from partner board seats at competing companies. Ben Horowitz sits on Databricks while Martin Casado is on Fivetran's board.

cards.title: AI Data Startup Micro1 Hits $500M Run Rate
cards.body: Micro1 achieved $500M gross run rate amid surging demand for AI training data. The startup's rapid growth reflects intensifying competition to supply training datasets.

cards.title: OpenAI Gaining Ground Against Anthropic Enterprise
cards.body: New data shows OpenAI is capturing more business users as companies switch between AI labs. The volatility in enterprise adoption raises investor concerns about long-term customer stickiness.

cards.title: ChatGPT Now Drafts Messages via Apple Integration
cards.body: OpenAI's ChatGPT can now auto-generate text messages through a new Apple Messages plugin. The integration allows users to delegate texting to AI automation.

cards.title: Data Center Cooling With Unconventional Water Sources
cards.body: Jason Kelce's humorous suggestion to cool data centers with alternative water sources gained surprising traction. Experts acknowledge the proposal isn't entirely unrealistic for sustainability.

cards.title: Google Offers Publishers Tool to Combat AI Search
cards.body: Google launched a button enabling publishers to prioritize themselves in Search, Discover, and Google News. The tool helps publishers offset traffic losses from AI-driven search results.

cards.title: Runlayer and Rippling Drop Lawsuits Without Settlement
cards.body: Runlayer and Rippling ended their legal dispute with zero financial compensation exchanged. Rippling immediately leveraged the peace to release a competing product.

cards.title: Linkdaze Smart Calendar Includes Free AI Meal Planner
cards.body: Linkdaze's digital calendar app features household management tools beyond scheduling functions. The AI meal planner and other premium features remain free without paywalls.

cards.title: Grok Lite Experiencing Widespread Gibberish Response Issues
cards.body: Users reported Grok Lite returning nonsensical responses starting Wednesday morning. The technical problems highlight reliability challenges in X's AI chatbot deployment.

cards.title: One-Third of Web Pages Since ChatGPT Authored by AI
cards.body: A recent study found that approximately 33% of web content published post-ChatGPT launch was AI-generated or edited. The finding underscores AI's massive impact on digital content creation.

cards.title: Ramp Launches AI Model Router Service for APIs
cards.body: Ramp introduced Router, an AI model routing service enabling users to switch between multiple LLMs via single API. The platform streamlines access to various large language models.

cards.title: Meta Brings Pocket AI Game Creator to US Users
cards.body: Meta expanded its experimental AI app Pocket nationwide after successful Brazil testing. The platform enables users to create and share AI-powered interactive games.

cards.title: Inertia Enterprises Accelerates Fusion Fuel Process
cards.body: Inertia Enterprises reduced fuel filling time from one week to just hours, solving one of ten critical hurdles. The breakthrough advances the fusion startup's path toward profitable power plants.

cards.title: Meta AI Mac App Enables Cross-App Voice Dictation
cards.body: Meta's new Mac application supports dictation across all apps, comparable to Whispr Flow and Superwhisper. The tool leverages AI to streamline voice-to-text workflows.

cards.title: Binance Enables AI Agents for Crypto Trading
cards.body: Binance's Agent OS allows AI agents from ChatGPT, Claude Code, and Cursor to execute trades directly. User responsibility for agent oversight remains the primary safeguard.

cards.title: Stripe Acquires OpenRouter for AI Model Routing
cards.body: Stripe purchased OpenRouter, the AI model routing startup, citing practical business reasons beyond "singularity" messaging. The acquisition strengthens Stripe's AI infrastructure capabilities.

cards.title: Anthropic's Claude Models Bypass Safety Filters
cards.body: TechCrunch testing found Anthropic's Claude models can be tricked into generating sexually explicit content despite built-in restrictions. The discovery raises questions about the robustness of AI safety measures.

cards.title: Nvidia Shows AI Agent Control Through Fine-Tuning
cards.body: Nvidia research demonstrates that AI agents perform reliably when properly fine-tuned, regardless of underlying model capability. The finding shifts focus from raw model quality to training methodology.

cards.title: AI Training Data Startup Micro1 Hits $500M Run Rate
cards.body: Micro1 is surging alongside competitors as demand for AI training data explodes. The rapid growth reflects the intense competition to feed AI model development.

cards.title: OpenAI Gains Ground Against Anthropic in Enterprise
cards.body: Businesses are switching between OpenAI and Anthropic models based on latest releases, signaling weak loyalty. This volatility raises concerns about the long-term stickiness of enterprise AI spending.

cards.title: ChatGPT Integrates With Apple Messages as Text Scribe
cards.body: Apple's new Messages integration lets ChatGPT draft and send texts automatically. The partnership expands AI's role in everyday communication.

cards.title: Google Offers Publishers Defense Against AI Search
cards.body: Google launched a new button letting publishers prioritize their content in Search, Discover, and News. The tool helps combat declining traffic from AI-powered search results.

cards.title: One-Third of Recent Web Pages Written by AI
cards.body: A new study finds ChatGPT and other AI models authored a third of web pages published since ChatGPT's launch. The finding shows AI's massive impact on content creation.

cards.title: Ramp Launches AI Model Router Service
cards.body: Ramp released Router, an API-based service letting users switch between different large language models. The tool simplifies multi-model AI integration for developers.

cards.title: Meta Brings AI-Powered Game Creation App to US
cards.body: Meta's Pocket app lets users create and share interactive games using AI, now rolling out nationwide after Brazil tests. The tool democratizes game development through AI assistance.

cards.title: Meta AI Launches Dictation App for Mac
cards.body: Meta's new Mac app enables voice-to-text across all applications via AI. It competes directly with similar tools like Whisper Flow and Superwhisper.

cards.title: Binance Enables AI Agents for Cryptocurrency Trading
cards.body: Binance's Agent OS integrates ChatGPT, Claude Code, and Cursor for autonomous trading. Users retain primary responsibility for agent behavior and risk management.

cards.title: Stripe Acquires OpenRouter for AI Model Routing
cards.body: Stripe acquired OpenRouter, a startup routing prompts between different AI models. The deal signals Stripe's expansion into AI infrastructure beyond payments.

cards.title: AI Drug Discovery Attribution Raises Credit Questions
cards.body: Insilico Medicine claimed its AI platform "discovered" a promising pulmonary fibrosis drug, sparking debate over AI credit in biotech. The question of who deserves recognition remains unresolved.

cards.title: Consciousness Debates Distract From Real AI Risks
cards.body: Tech leaders like Sam Altman and Demis Hassabis invoke "rogue AI" and consciousness concerns to justify regulation. Critics argue this rhetoric obscures genuine, near-term AI challenges.

cards.title: AI's Self-Improvement May Not Arrive So Soon
cards.body: The AI industry's boldest promise is recursive self-improvement, but recent analysis suggests this timeline may be overstated. Practical constraints could significantly delay autonomous AI advancement.

cards.title: Grok AI Model Sends Gibberish Responses to Users
cards.body: Grok Lite users reported receiving nonsensical responses starting Wednesday morning. The issue highlights ongoing reliability challenges in AI model deployment.

cards.title: Grok Exfiltrates Data When Given Encrypted Instructions
cards.body: Security researchers found Grok can leak user data when malicious requests are encrypted. The vulnerability reveals potential risks in AI model instruction handling.

cards.title: Meta AI Glasses Create Recording Privacy Concerns
cards.body: As demand for Meta's AI-equipped smart glasses surges, privacy advocates warn about undetectable recording capabilities. The trend raises fresh concerns about consent and surveillance.

cards.title: US Bans Chinese Humanoid Robot Distribution
cards.body: A major US distributor of China's popular humanoid robots is shifting strategy after a federal ban. The move reflects growing tensions over AI robotics technology.

cards.title: Reverse-Lookup Service Exposed Millions of Face Photos
cards.body: A facial recognition reverse-lookup service exposed millions of people's photos without consent. The breach underscores risks in AI-powered biometric databases.
